question: Which drama received the 2025 Pulitzer Prize for Drama?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Purpose**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The Pulitzer Prize for Drama is awarded annually to recognize outstanding theatrical works performed in the United States.
 
• **Purpose**, written and performed by a distinguished playwright, received the 2025 Pulitzer Prize for Drama.
 
• The play explores themes of identity, resilience, and societal issues, resonating with audiences and critics alike.
 
• The Pulitzer Prize board acknowledged the play for its exceptional storytelling, character development, and impactful social commentary.
 
• "Purpose" was staged in prominent theaters and received widespread acclaim for its innovative narrative and cultural relevance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Pulitzer Prize:** Established in 1917 by provisions in the will of Joseph Pulitzer, it honors excellence in journalism, literature, and musical composition.
 
• **Drama Category:** Recognizes original plays that have been performed during the preceding calendar year in the United States.
 
• **Criteria:** Plays are judged on their artistic merit, originality, and ability to address contemporary issues effectively.
 
• **Notable Past Winners:** Include works such as "Hamilton" by Lin-Manuel Miranda (2016) and "A Strange Loop" by Michael R. Jackson (2020).
 
• **Significance:** The award boosts the visibility and legacy of playwrights and their works, often leading to further opportunities in theater and media adaptations.
